exposure: rs1036819 polymorphism in the ZFAT gene
cohort: 826 postmenopausal women (568 evaluated; 315 with POP stages III and IV and 253 controls with stages 0 and I)
finding: No association was detected between the rs1036819 polymorphism of the ZFAT gene and advanced POP, while age, number of pregnancies, at least one vaginal delivery, weight of the newborn, and POP family history were independent risk factors.
mod_finding: At least one vaginal delivery was found to be an independent risk factor for POP, whereas one or more cesarean sections were found to be protective.
